newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-JIM BEAM TO BOOST EXPORTS TO LITHUANIA.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-JIM BEAM TO BOOST EXPORTS TO LITHUANIA.

text.p: Jim Beam Brands Worldwide, owned by U.S. consumer goods giant American Brands , wants to boost its exports of Jim Beam to Lithuania by 15-20 percent this year, newspaper Verslo Zinios repoted.
Tom Wilen, president of Jim Beam Brands Worldwide, was quoted as saying that his recent visit was successful and the company intends to boost exports by 15 to 20 percent this year.
Jim Beam exports four and eight year old whiskey and one brand of cocktails and intends to expand the range.
Wilen was quoted as saying that the company started investing in the Baltics in 1991 but declined to mention the size of the investments.
The company exports to Estonia three times more than to Lithuania and Wilen was quoted as saying that the Estonian tax system was more flexible.
The distributor of Jim Beam in Lithuania is Mineraliniai Vandenys (Mineral Water).
